name: Canvas for AI
description: Tools where AI agents can show work that people can use, edit, or listen to.

tools.name: UI Design Editor
tools.summary: A shared editor where people and agents can view and change designs together.
use_when: Show a design the user can edit.
Make or change a page or app mockup.
Move or resize parts of a screenshot.
Work with the user in a shared design project.
not_for: Build and host a working website.
Play text or documents as audio.

access.auth: No signup. A Space or project link grants access to the shared work.
requirements: A browser that exposes the page's WebMCP site tools to the agent.
The full Space or project URL when opening existing work.

limits: Anyone with a Space or project link can view and edit every project in that Space.
Keep the full #space and &project values in shared links.
The agent must use the browser's site tools for edits.
PNG export keeps a GIF as a still image.

tools.name: PDF TO MP3
tools.summary: A document reader where people can listen one sentence at a time, read along, and ask about the text.
use_when: Let the user listen to an answer or other text.
Turn a PDF or document into speech.
Let the user read along and replay each sentence.
Give the user document or chapter audio as MP3 files.
not_for: Show an interactive chart or a custom web page.

access.auth: Sign in to Document Player and approve the connection.
requirements: An agent app with Streamable HTTP MCP support.
For prepared document speech, a saved OpenAI or Gemini speech key.

access.auth: Connect the user's Document Player account through PDFTOMP3-Plugin.
requirements: Install PDFTOMP3-Plugin in Codex and connect the account.
Follow the installed plugin's current setup and reading guides.

limits: Sending text returns a reader link; it does not open a window or start playback.
The user opens the reader and presses Play.
Listening needs an account and uses the service's speech allowance or billing.
Prepared document speech uses the user's saved speech key and can incur charges.
For send_to_doc_player, passages expire after 30 days; an account can keep 100 passages of up to 100,000 characters each.
A PDF is not a direct input to send_to_doc_player; read it first or use the document workflow.
